You are implementing Isaac's section of LARP: market adapters, transaction execution, the isolated signer and autonomous recovery.

Start on branch codex/execution-recovery from the team's shared kickoff commit on origin/codex/engine-foundation. Read AGENTS.md, docs/skill/SKILL.md, the LEDGER table, relevant INCOMPLETE_WORK items and docs/build/PARALLEL_BUILD.md. That brief is part of this prompt. Read verbatim kit trading/authentication/API sections, their participant-kit.md summaries, IDEA-013 signer/probe findings and IDEA-021 ENG-05/06. Do not copy superseded same-nonce clearing from IDEA-020. Record work in IDEA-027.

Own larp/marketdata/, larp/execution/, their tests/configuration and tools/probe_quote.py. Begin with recorded/synthetic API responses, an isolated fake signer, fake chain and fake durable-command receipts. Implement observe(Document) -> Document and pure advance(state, observation) -> ExecutionTransition.v1. Unit work must not depend on Keegan's real database or Keith's policy.

Deliver:
1. Typed read-only adapters for eligible tokens, decimals, both market-state endpoints, size/side-bound quotes, balances and transaction observations. Bind observations to issuer/token identity, timestamps, source/hash and freshness. Correct 401/403 diagnosis, integer/HTTP-date Retry-After handling, backoff/budgets and response validation. Both bStock market flags must permit trading. Support an opt-in quote/state logger for cost/availability measurement; quotes are not fills and logging research data is not permission to trade.
2. One approve-confirm-requote-estimate-validate-sign-broadcast-reconcile state machine used by fake, paper and real execution adapters. Paper must lack signer/broadcast capabilities. Preserve run/round/decision/intent/step/attempt/hash identity; recognize success, revert, ambiguous and final outcomes. No generic cancel or same-nonce replacement capability by default.
3. Separate economic-action validation for approve, eligible bStock swap and USDT-to-BNB gas maintenance. Verify actual encoded tokens/amounts, spender/router/selector, recipient, minimum output, deadline where applicable, chain/wallet/nonce/value and gas limits. Prove supported ABI/route decoding; refuse unsupported routes and failed gas estimates instead of relying on unsafe demo fallbacks.
4. Consume only atomically authorized, durably recorded commands from the store. Recheck current ownership epoch and applicable health/risk/market/expiry gates at both signing and broadcasting. Persist signature bytes securely and local hash before broadcast; record possible submission before the network call. Do not expose signed payloads in general audit logs. Do not hold the database transaction across network/signing calls.
5. Wallet-wide nonce/finality recovery with bounded probes, reservations retained through ambiguity and all alternate hashes preserved. Missing history, a timeout or elapsed quote expiry is not evidence that an action cannot settle. Unknown outgoing transactions or stale restored ownership block signing. A late confirmation must not cause a duplicate economic trade. Return actual fills, failed-attempt gas and residual quantities for shared accounting.

Acceptance: synthetic ABI tampering, approval delay beyond buy expiry, lost broadcast response, crash at every durable boundary, stale owner epoch, unknown nonce consumer, delayed success/revert, insufficient gas, API throttling, closed markets, unsupported routes and reorg/finality evidence. Fail safely with a cause/next-probe/deadline, not an infinite retry. Fake execution must use the same state machine as the real path. Relevant AT06/07/08/09/17 need reproducible fixtures; disabled replacement is recorded as disabled, not tested success.

Details needed for opt-in real integration: BINANCE_API_KEY/BINANCE_SECRET_KEY (map to BN_WEB3 aliases), registered AI_SEEDS_ADDRESS, approved read/finality route capabilities and funded BNB evidence. WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY OR WALLET_MNEMONIC is provisioned only on the isolated signer host, never supplied in chat or to all developers. AI_SEEDS_SECRET belongs to the audit service, not this module. A key alone does not authorize a live trade.

Commit/push code and criteria before any test or probe. Start entirely offline; do not broadcast a transaction as part of this prompt. Deliver one successful fake approve/swap trace, one ambiguous-outcome/recovery trace, capability evidence versus unsupported capabilities, exact test commands and remaining real-world inputs. Keegan reviews; integration uses his durable store and Keith's accounting/risk authorization.
